subject: Re: SIG evidence packet — data retention, session logs, and redaction status
messages:
From: security@acmetech.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia@compliancehub.io>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Evidence request — retention & session logs

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this. Acme's security review team is collecting SIG evidence for our Q2 audit. We need the following artifacts for the SIG privacy & data lifecycle questions by EOD Friday (2027-04-23):

- Data retention matrix (per data class) and retention policy excerpts
- Sample session log exports (redacted) covering 30 days
- Diagram of session flow and network boundaries (png/pdf)
- Controls around key material: KMS rotation playbook and proof of rotation cadence
- Any runbooks for on-call retrieval of session logs and access audit screenshots

Prefer Drive links to shared artifacts. If any items are sensitive, indicate redaction approach and provide a redacted sample.

Regards,
Acme Security Team
security@acmetech.com

---
Accompanying note: Please include a manifest CSV with filenames, owners, and any redaction flags.

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG: Evidence request — retention & session logs

Team — forwarding Acme's list. Target: compile and share a Drive folder by Thu COB so we have one day buffer. Quick assignments: 

- Marcus: retention matrix + retention policy snippets (attach retention_matrix.xlsx and an excerpts PDF)
- Priyom: session logs export and on-call runbook screenshots (redact PII before share)
- Kimberly: network/session diagram + whiteboard recording of team walkthrough (we'll record 30 min)

Please add filenames to an evidence_manifest_v2.csv and flag any items needing redaction. If any artifacts are sensitive (security keys, long-lived credentials), do NOT upload — instead include a redaction note and a sanitized screenshot.

I'll coordinate replies to Acme and handle sharing permissions. If you expect delays, call me.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG: Evidence request — retention & session logs

Hi all — attaching the retention matrix (retention_matrix.xlsx) and a short excerpt PDF of the Data Retention Policy (redacted for HR-specific clauses). Drive folder (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIjKLmNopQ

Notes:
- Retention matrix includes data classes, owners, retention periods and delete/archival actions.
- We redacted employee-only columns (HR identifiers) from the public excerpt. Full policy is flagged in the manifest as "restricted" and will require a signed NDA for full access — noting in the manifest.
- KMS rotation playbook (kms_rotation_playbook.pdf) is included; it references rotation cadence and automated checks. No raw key material is present.

I uploaded a draft evidence_manifest_v2.csv with owners and redaction flags. Priyom — please confirm the session logs export format (we need to agree fields to redact).

Marcus Lin
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@compliancehub.io>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmetech.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Evidence request — retention & session logs

Thanks, Stephanie and Marcus — this is helpful. A few follow-ups from Acme's reviewer:

- The matrix looks good; can you include a short note linking retention actions to automations (e.g., delete jobs, lifecycle policies)?
- For session logs: we need one redacted sample in CSV and 1 screenshot of the audit log UI filtered for the last 30 days (showing columns and filters). The sample CSV should keep timestamps but remove user identifiers (replace with pseudonyms).
- Network diagram: the PNG looks fine but could you export the draw.io source or a higher-resolution version.
- Whiteboard: if you have a recording of your walkthrough explaining end-to-end session handling, please attach (MP4 or link). We treat recordings as sensitive — redaction note required if participant names are visible.

Can we schedule a 20-minute call Wed 2027-04-21 10:00 AM PT for a quick handoff? If so, send a calendar invite.

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Senior Compliance Analyst — ComplianceHub
olivia@compliancehub.io

Hi Olivia / Acme security —

Following up with the compiled artifacts. Shared Drive link (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIjKLmNopQ
Contents:
- evidence_manifest_v2.csv (manifest with filenames, owners, redaction flags)
- retention_matrix.xlsx (per-data-class retention matrix)
- data-retention-excerpt.pdf (redacted policy excerpt)
- session-logs-sample-redacted.csv (30-day sample, user ids pseudonymized)
- audit-ui-screenshot-20270330.png (UI screenshot filtered to login events)
- network-diagram.drawio.png (high-res export)
- whiteboard_session_20270418.mp4 (30-min walkthrough; participant names blurred)
- kms_rotation_playbook.pdf (procedural playbook; no key material included)

Redaction notes: we removed PII (emails, employee IDs) from CSVs and blurred participant names in the recording. The manifest flags three artifacts as "restricted" (full policy, raw logs archive, redaction mapping) — these require a signed DPA/NDA and will be provided under a controlled share.

We are available for the 20-minute handoff Wed 2027-04-21 10:00 AM PT — invite sent separately. If you need any additional screenshots (e.g., expanded audit filters) or a short clip highlighting the KMS rotation steps, let me know and we will extract them.

Thanks — Stephanie
